title: Render bounded catalog snapshots and deltas
objective: Render deterministic developer-role snapshot, upsert, and revoke payloads while honoring metadata budgets and visibility.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid design: an initial developer-role catalog snapshot, append-only upsert/revoke deltas, on-demand SKILL.md bodies, and an authoritative execution registry.
The repository is a dirty shared worktree. Preserve unrelated changes and modify only owned_files.

source_evidence.note: Codex uses a bounded initial metadata catalog and loads full SKILL.md on demand.
Claude Code supports live skill discovery, visibility overrides, and on-demand skill bodies.
Append-only conversation messages preserve the previously cached prompt prefix.

include: Render initial snapshot and append-only delta formats with revision markers.
Preserve all visible names while dropping low-priority descriptions under budget.
Never expose descriptions for name-only/manual-only/off entries.
Use deterministic ordering independent of map iteration.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Implement pure renderers over precomputed contract values.
Add golden tests for snapshot, upsert, revoke, truncation, escaping, and empty delta.
Prove no-change input renders no message.
acceptance_criteria: Rendered output is deterministic and bounded.
Revokes carry stable ID and reason.
Renderer does not read files or mutate catalog state.
dispatch_prompt: Implement pure bounded catalog snapshot/delta renderers in new files. Take IDs/digests/revisions as inputs; do not depend on task_03 implementation.
notes_for_assignee: Keep the diff narrow; if a dependency contract is insufficient, report the required change to the integrator instead of editing another task's files.
